title: Parish Church of Trindade

identityStatus: The mapped Q26257457 footprint and named site node match the old parish church in the cleared image. The geometry gives the overall perimeter. Tower section, roof geometry, and rear are photo estimates.

mappedIdentity.name: Igreja Matriz do Divino Pai Eterno

terrainContact.basis: Original public terrain close to the entrance and southeast steps.

notes: The August 2024 exterior of Igreja Matriz do Divino Pai Eterno in Trindade, Goiás, with blue trim, two pointed-roof towers, clock gable, and long nave. This is the 1912 Santuário Velho overlooking the original square. The 2024 photograph supplies the blue and white appearance. Off-camera openings and roof forms are approximate.
